evidence_to_attach: Baseline, target process, pilot sample, measurement method, exclusions, observed result notes
go_condition: Evidence is enough for the next controlled operating step
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: Value is anecdotal, baseline is missing, or result cannot be separated from manual effort
safe_claim_boundary: Do not claim ROI, revenue, savings or customer impact unless measured and approved

evidence_to_attach: Test set, failed examples, acceptance threshold, regression history, rollback path
go_condition: Known failure modes are documented and monitored
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: Critical failures unresolved or no regression gate exists
safe_claim_boundary: Do not claim accuracy, reliability or safety beyond tested scope

evidence_to_attach: Data classes, retention position, access roles, vendor/subprocessor notes, redaction controls
go_condition: Use is scoped, approved and visible to responsible owners
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: Customer-sensitive data, regulated data or identity exposure is unclear
safe_claim_boundary: Do not claim compliance, certification or security approval without adviser-approved evidence

evidence_to_attach: Token/API/cloud usage, expected volume, owner budget, alert thresholds, spend assumptions
go_condition: Scale-cost assumptions have a named owner and stop threshold
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: Unit economics unknown or no owner can stop spend
safe_claim_boundary: Do not claim cost reduction or savings without measured baseline and approved calculation

evidence_to_attach: Runbook, human review point, incident route, support owner, change gate, weekly review cadence
go_condition: Humans know how to supervise, pause and improve the system
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: Production support depends on builder or informal heroics
safe_claim_boundary: Do not claim managed production readiness unless support ownership is active

evidence_to_attach: Approved wording, unsupported claims list, proof boundary, customer-facing disclaimer
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: ROI, compliance, security or customer-result claims are unsupported
safe_claim_boundary: Only repeat claims backed by attached evidence and explicit approval

evidence_to_attach: Go / restricted go / redesign / pause / no-go rationale and next review date
go_condition: Decision is explicit and signed by required owners
no_go_or_restricted_launch_trigger: Decision is implied, rushed or missing owner sign-off
safe_claim_boundary: Readiness decision only; not a guarantee of production success
